name: 3-MA
summary: 3-Methoxyamphetamine (3-MA), also known as meta-methoxyamphetamine (MMA), is a monoamine releasing agent (MRA) of the amphetamine family. It is a positional isomer of para-methoxyamphetamine (PMA; 4-methoxyamphetamine). The drug has been encountered as a novel designer drug.

pharmacology.text: 3-MA is a combined serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (SNDRA) rather than a fairly selective serotonin releasing agent (SSRA) like the related drug para-methoxyamphetamine (PMA; 4-MA). Its EC50 values for induction of monoamine release were reported to be 58 nM for norepinephrine and 103 nM for dopamine in rat brain synaptosomes, whereas the value for serotonin was not reported.

uses.text: The drug has been encountered as a novel designer drug.

summaryZh: 間甲氧基安非他命 ，也稱為3-甲氧基安非他命，是一種安非他命類的興奮劑。它在動物藥物鑑別測試中的作用與更廣為人知的位置異構物4-甲氧基安非他命相似 ，儘管其導致的單胺類神經遞質釋放比率略有不同，且它是血清素、多巴胺和去甲基腎上腺素的釋放劑，而不是如PMA的結合選擇性血清素釋放劑。
